name: nexaiot-platform
description: Scalable IoT monitoring platform for MQTT and EMQX with Cloudflare Pages frontend.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@nexaiot/shared && npm run build --workspace=@nexaiot/mqtt && npm run build --workspace=@nexaiot/config && npm run build --workspace=@nexaiot/validation && npm run build --workspace=@nexaiot/api && npm run build --workspace=@nexaiot/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=@nexaiot/shared && npm run lint --workspace=@nexaiot/mqtt && npm run lint --workspace=@nexaiot/config && npm run lint --workspace=@nexaiot/validation && npm run lint --workspace=@nexaiot/api && npm run lint --workspace=@nexaiot/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@nexaiot/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@nexaiot/mqtt && npm run typecheck --workspace=@nexaiot/config && npm run typecheck --workspace=@nexaiot/validation && npm run typecheck --workspace=@nexaiot/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@nexaiot/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@nexaiot/shared && npm run test --workspace=@nexaiot/mqtt && npm run test --workspace=@nexaiot/config && npm run test --workspace=@nexaiot/validation && npm run test --workspace=@nexaiot/api && npm run test --workspace=@nexaiot/web
scripts.build:cloudflare: npm run build --workspace=@nexaiot/shared && npm run build --workspace=@nexaiot/web
